seckey_file.description: Path to the secret key file used for signing.

pubkey_file.description: Path to the public key file, primarily for reference or if needed for verification scripts.

trusted_comment.description: Trusted comment to include in the signature. Verified by the recipient.

untrusted_comment.description: Untrusted comment to include in the signature. Can be modified after signing.

files_to_sign.description: List of file paths to sign with minisign.
